purpose: Teach: 申し込み/専攻/子会社/持ち主/一環/一括/圧縮/復旧

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、お得意様の、絶対、申し込み、絶対、自分で、絶対、対応したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the early days, my father handled every important customer request himself — no shortcuts, no exceptions.
lines.style: Measured, reverent tone. Slight emphasis on 「絶対」 moments — not lecturing, but testifying. Voice carries the weight of decades observed. Pause before the final phrase, like he's passing something forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、社員の、絶対、専攻、絶対、分野、絶対、活かしてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've made it our practice to cultivate our employees' expertise in their fields — we're deeply grateful for that foundation.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Precise articulation on 「活かしてまいりました」. Slight bow in the voice — not servile, but acknowledging something larger than himself. Steady, composed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、子会社、絶対、自分で、絶対、立ち上げたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: My father founded subsidiaries with his own hands — built them from the ground up.
lines.style: Quieter here. A note of wistfulness — not sadness, but the tenderness of remembering someone no longer here. Voice slightly distant, as if seeing back through time. Trailing off gently on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、持ち主、絶対、関係、絶対、続いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's generation, we've maintained those relationships with our key partners and shop owners — that continuity means everything to us.
lines.style: Reflective, almost ceremonial. Speaks slowly enough that each phrase lands. The voice carries both continuity and responsibility. Gentle but unwavering conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、社会貢献の、絶対、一環、絶対、寄付、絶対、続けたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: My father kept up a practice of giving back — donations, community support — he never wavered from that commitment.
lines.style: Voice softens. There's admiration here, maybe even a hint of personal challenge in how he speaks it. Not self-congratulatory — more like he's saying: this is what matters. Small pause before the closing words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、お得意様、絶対、一括、絶対、ご注文、絶対、対応してまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've taken care to respond to bulk orders from our valued clients quickly and thoughtfully — that's the legacy we're standing in.
lines.style: Warm and steady. 「感謝」 carries genuine feeling, not just formality. Voice opens slightly here — more personal. Like he's speaking to someone who would understand what that legacy asks of you.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、商品の、絶対、圧縮、絶対、保管、絶対、工夫したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: My father was ingenious about storage — finding ways to preserve and compress inventory efficiently so nothing was wasted.
lines.style: Wistful, almost affectionate. There's a small smile in the voice — the memory of something clever, something earned. Slower pace, like he's visualizing it. Voice trails softly at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、業務、絶対、復旧、絶対、いかなる時も、絶対、迅速に進めてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's era, we've made sure that whenever operations needed recovery, we moved swiftly and decisively — every single time, without exception. We carry that forward with gratitude.
lines.style: Voice grows more solemn and measured. This feels like a culmination. Emphasis on 「いかなる時も」 — the universality of the commitment. Closes with quiet conviction, like a promise being renewed. Deliberate, unhurried.
